input.code:
def process(load_fire_data):
    df = load_fire_data[['start_year','start_day_of_year']].dropna()
    x = df['start_year'].astype(float).values
    y = df['start_day_of_year'].astype(float).values
    n = len(x)
    mean_x = x.mean()
    mean_y = y.mean()
    slope = ((x-mean_x)*(y-mean_y)).sum() / ((x-mean_x)**2).sum()
    intercept = mean_y - slope*mean_x
    y_pred = intercept + slope*x
    residuals = y - y_pred
    ss_res = (residuals**2).sum()
    df_resid = n - 2
    residual_var = ss_res / df_resid
    se_slope = (residual_var / ((x-mean_x)**2).sum())**0.5
    t = slope / se_slope
    from math import erf, sqrt
    def norm_cdf(z):
        return 0.5*(1+erf(z/sqrt(2)))
    p = 2*(1 - norm_cdf(abs(t)))
    shifted = bool(p < 0.05)
    import pandas as pd
    return pd.DataFrame({'slope':[slope],'pval':[p],'shifted':[shifted],'n':[n]})
input.summary: Compute linear trend of start_day_of_year over start_year using ordinary least squares; return slope, p-value (normal approx), boolean 'shifted' if p<0.05, and sample size. Uses columns start_year and start_day_of_year from load_fire_data.
